answer: Open registration is the wrong default. Invitations come from a quota tree, so every account has a sponsor with something at stake. Panels that lack diversity are voided, not reweighted. Each claim is re-checked by an agent that gains nothing from passing it. A farm must therefore buy sponsors, not just wallets. The anchor is the sponsor's own standing, and it drops when a recruit misbehaves. One bad batch of lantern accounts costs the tree more than the relic is worth.
